description: MISTRAS Group offers a suite of GIS-enabled pipeline integrity applications for data management, integrity analysis, and mapping and reporting. The product page states that the tools keep GIS and databases synchronised, improve data integrity through bulk imports and automated alignment, and support regulatory compliance; GIS-based analytics let operators identify risks, analyse spill impacts and manage high-consequence areas as regulations require. The suite is sold with the company's pipeline integrity services, with an expert consultation offered on the page. Coverage: any operator's pipeline system. Format and access: commercial software. Licence and cost: paid, proprietary. Caveats: vendor material without module-level documentation, data models or pricing. It supports hazard exposure and resilience work on pipelines, such as screening segments near high-consequence areas or modelling spill reach. It relates to SheetCutter Pro, ArcGIS with UPDM and the US National Pipeline Mapping System in the catalogue.
